name: What is the difference between a roof inspection and a roof estimate consultation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a roof inspection and a roof estimate consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A roof inspection is a detailed examination of your roof's condition to identify problems, often performed without an immediate intent to repair or replace. A roof estimate consultation, while including an inspection, specifically focuses on assessing damage or wear and then providing a formal quote for the recommended work. Discounted Roofing Co. uses the consultation to combine both the diagnostic inspection and the financial proposal, streamlining the process for our customers.
acceptedAnswer.description: An inspection assesses roof condition; a consultation includes that assessment plus a formal quote for recommended work.
